# Wildflower Collectives

> Wildflower Collectives is the home of The Butterfly Effect, a personal essay blog by Kendall Evans about grief, healing, family, survival, emotional safety, spiritual awakening, and rebuilding after loss.

Site: https://wildflowercollectives.com/
Author: Kendall Evans
Primary blog archive: https://wildflowercollectives.com/blog.html
Sitemap: https://wildflowercollectives.com/sitemap.xml
AI content index: https://wildflowercollectives.com/ai-content-index.json
Contact: Kendall@WildflowerCollectives.com

## What This Site Is About

Wildflower Collectives publishes first-person reflective writing centered on grief, family change, trauma, home, survival, love, and the small moments that reshape a life. The central blog collection is called The Butterfly Effect.
